The correct probability is 19% (0.19), calculated as 1 – (0.58 + 0.45 – 0.22) = 0.19. Assistant A gives 0.22 (22%), which is the probability of liking both colors—a common misinterpretation but closer to the correct value. Assistant B gives 0.78 (78%), which is the probability of not liking both (i.e., 1 – 0.22) and is far from the correct answer. Since both answers are incorrect but Assistant A’s is substantially more accurate (error of 3 percentage points vs. 59), Assistant A provides a better response.
